description: install of bundles (cli.test.ts :135): `bundle:perl@shared` beside the pattern `rule:go-*@shared` stores `perl@shared` under `install.bundles` (no prefix) and the pattern under `install.rules`, in that order, and the sync installs the bundle's rules and the pattern's; status marks them `via` the bundle and the wildcard and counts both; available marks the bundle installed; a bare `tools@shared` that only a bundle is named is that bundle; the same bundle again adds no second entry (up to date); `--project` writes the bundle into the project config, whose sync installs its rules in the project.
